description: This Java class defines a message object 'StartChildActor' used for starting child actors within an Akka actor system. It encapsulates actor properties and the actor's name, providing methods for access, equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: StartChildActor
classes.description: Immutable message class used to request the start of a child actor with specified properties and name.

methods.name: StartChildActor
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the message with actor props and name.

methods.name: getProps
methods.description: Returns the Props object defining the child's actor configuration.

methods.name: getActorName
methods.description: Returns the name to assign to the child actor.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another StartChildActor instance based on props and actorName.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on props and actorName.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the StartChildActor instance.
